## Definition
The process where learning induces directional asymmetries in the network's parameter space, breaking isotropic symmetry and creating ordered structures. Guides iNEST hardware design by identifying which synaptic or routing dimensions require asymmetric resource allocation, optimizing energy and latency in neuromorphic fabrics.
